name: Crush
summary: Charm's terminal coding agent: multi-model (OpenAI- or Anthropic-compatible APIs), session-based, LSP-enhanced and extensible with MCP servers.
description: Switch models mid-session while keeping context; MCP over `http`, `stdio` and `sse`. Runs on macOS, Linux, Windows (PowerShell and WSL), Android, FreeBSD, OpenBSD and NetBSD. Licensed under the Functional Source License 1.1 with MIT future license (source-available, converts to MIT).
